originals: earliest current-period original 10-Q or 10-K; retain all later versions separately
availability: filing date plus one calendar day, owner approved assumption
horizon: next full native fiscal quarter at previous fiscal quarter end
features: seasonal/latest revenue ratio; no issuer or additional regressors
target: target/latest revenue ratio, converted to dollars with known latest revenue
algorithm: ridge alpha 1, unpenalized intercept, training-only scaling
feature_rule: latest available standalone quarter and same fiscal quarter previous fiscal year; no Q4 derivation; no predecessor splicing
split_rule: for each issuer and each diagnostic lane, last eight eligible origins with at least 20 available training labels; require all three issuers to have eight; freeze case IDs and training IDs before fitting
accounting_rule: Both features and target must share one issuer accounting regime. Pooling within-regime ratios across regimes is an exploratory transfer assumption, not a claim of accounting equivalence.
evaluation_disposition: ELIGIBLE_PROXY_ONLY if all coverage, lineage, accounting and timestamp-convention gates pass
publication_note: Selected fields from the historical contract. Original full-contract hash remains in the frozen split.
